integrity: The theorem is proved by transition-phase uniqueness and a circular desubstitution equivalence; finite prefix computations are supplementary. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The cyclic source-window count is an exact finite-length characterization, not a closed numerical formula for every multiple. No assertion is made that every multiple has a nonzero count. Base two is excluded. Finite diagnostics are not infinite proofs; originality remains subject to unindexed antecedents.
title: A sharp congruence obstruction and cyclic desubstitution for generalized Mephisto–Waltz words
